build_vlm_pipeline: build a VLM pipeline to convert PDF documents using vision-language model inference
run_vlm_pipeline_pdf: run the VLM pipeline on a PDF file with doctags response format for document extraction
configure_api_vlm_options: configure API-based VLM options to process documents via remote vision-language model endpoints
configure_inline_vlm_model: configure an inline VLM model using HuggingFace Transformers or MLX inference framework
assemble_vlm_document: assemble a DoclingDocument from VLM predictions in doctags, markdown, or HTML response format
